lines.en: Hey, I got you a present!
Oh, my goodness. Where did you hide it?
I got it for your wedding, and I ordered it weeks ago,
and it finally got here!
Phoebs, you didn't have to get us anything for our wedding.
You already did some--
I love it! It's huge! Let's open it! Open it!
It's the Ms. Passman machine!
Oh, my God!
I didn't know where to put it, so I just left it here for now.
Oh, well, maybe we could put it in the guest bedroom.
Yeah, okay.
I kind of like it here.
So do you really like it?
Are you kidding?
I practically spent my entire childhood at the arcade!
This was like-- Oh, my God! This was like my second favorite game!
Oh, really? What was your first?
Well, I don't really remember the name of it.
Well, what did it do?
Well, you just put a quarter in, and, you know, pull some handles,
and you win, like, a candy bar or something.
A vending machine?
Hey, don't feel bad for me! I won every time!
No!
Yes!
Oh!
Oh, would you look at that, Monica?
I just knocked off all your top scores. How sad.
Hmm.
Okay, I'm next.
No!
Don't start another game! I said I was next!
Phoebe!
Oh, I'm sorry. I couldn't hear you over all the winning.
Chandler!
Chandler, Phoebe's hogging the game!
Who cares? It's a stupid game.
Oh, you only think it's stupid 'cause you suck at it.
I don't suck. It sucks.
You suck.
Wait, okay, if this game is gonna cause problems between the two of you,
then maybe I should just keep it.
No, no, no, no, no! I love it! It is a great present!
But, you know, in fact, why don't you go home and wait for the thank-you card?
Why do you wanna play this game so badly?
Yeah, it's not like it spits out a Clark bar after every game.
Okay, maybe that's it. Come on, get out of the chair.
Come on, come on, out of the chair! Oh, come on!
Hey!
You are not gonna believe what I did today.
Well, it clearly wasn't showering or shaving.
I got good. I played this game all day, and now I rule at it.
They should change the name of it to Miss Chandler.
Although, I hope they don't.
Wait a minute. You stayed home all day and played Miss Pac-Man
while I went off to work like some kind of chump?
And I got all the top ten scores. I erased Phoebe off the board. High five!
What is the matter with your hand?
Well, I've been playing it for like eight hours.
It'll loosen up. Come on, check out the scores.
Oh, and also look at the initials. They're dirty words.
Chandler, why would you do that?
Because it's awesome.
You think this is clever?
Well, you know, they only give you three letters.
So after A-S-S, it is a bit of a challenge.
Wait a minute. This one's not dirty.
Well, it is when you put it together with that one.
Oh.
Well, if you don't clear this off, you won't be getting one of those from me.
Look, Ben's coming over here tomorrow to play this game. This can't be there.
Come on. He won't even know what they mean.
Chandler, he's seven. He's not stupid.
Have you talked to him lately?
All right, look. I'm just gonna unplug it.
No, no, no. If you unplug it, I'll have nothing to show for my day. It'll be like I was at work.
No.
Hey, look at that.
Look at that. It's still there. This thing must have some kind of primitive wrong chip in it or something.
Honey, you've got to beat your scores.
With the claw.
All right, fine. Fine. I'll do it. Just got to get this off the screen.
Carol and Susan are still upset that you taught him "pull my finger."
Pull my finger? My hand is messed up.
Sleep over there. I'll come back over here.
All right. Come on, this Pac-Man's got right.
Well, you're just a little bitch, aren't you?
Hey, you guys.
Listen, I'm sorry that I was hogging the game before.
Oh, my God.
Your friends have some unfortunate initials.
They're all Chandler.
Chandler sucks. He couldn't have gotten this good.
I did.
But it came at a price.
Oh.
Well, Ben's coming over tonight and he can't see this.
Oh, come on. By age seven, kids have already seen orgies.
Was it just me?
Fire!
I know!
One more score to go. You can do it!
Don't touch me! Don't touch her!
All right, go left. Go left. Go right! Go right!
I can't! I can't!
No! You son of a...
Beep!
Phoebe!
Oh, hi, Ben.
Now don't look at the machine!
